source: https://www.vjw.digital.go.jp/main/ (Visit Japan Web front-end: passport registration and entry-information checks, read 2026-10-15), plus https://services.digital.go.jp/en/visit-japan-web/ (Digital Agency service page)

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Use the passport number from the photo page: capital letters and digits, up to 9 (e.g. AB1234567).

errors.invalidFormat: Capital letters and digits only, up to 9

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: VJW has two boxes, family name and given name, up to 39 characters each, in capital letters A–Z, digits, spaces and - . , only. Check the name here in the same capitals.

errors.tooLong: Each name box on VJW takes up to 39 characters
errors.invalidChars: Capital letters A–Z, digits, spaces and - . , only

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Checked here as YYYY-MM-DD; on VJW it is three boxes: year, month, day.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

flight_number.label: Flight number
flight_number.help: Capital letters and digits only, no space, up to 20 — e.g. JL5, not JL 5.

errors.invalidFormat: Capital letters and digits only, no spaces (e.g. JL5)

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: YYYY/MM/DD, as VJW's date box hints. VJW takes today through 31 December of next year.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past

email.label: Email
email.help: Use the email tied to your Visit Japan Web account (up to 128 characters).
